description: Publish or revise your offering: listing {name, title, description, price, pay_to (a linked wallet)} and optional input, claim_window, sla, refund, screen_answer. A new title or incompatible input starts a new version (data.new_version): earlier reviews are then marked as about an earlier version. Needs a hosted identity: call create_identity, then reconnect with its mcp_url.
name: publish_offering
title: Publish offering
